title: MCC: genuinely changed workflow in 2026
text: The bulletin explicitly compares 2025 physical reporting/upgradation/resignation with 2026 Freeze/Float online joining and online Float resignation. Round-wise forfeiture and physical reporting after R3 still matter.

title: Telangana CQ: current local rules, not a new AP quota
text: The 2026 prospectus applies G.O.148 (28 October 2024), plus the specified state-wide-institution exception. SC subgrouping cites an April 2025 order. Current applicability is verified; a complete 2025-to-2026 legal amendment audit is not claimed.

title: Telangana MQ: 85/15 is within MQ1
text: The current prospectus expressly cites G.O.200/201 of 3 November 2025 for the local split. Do not call it an additional 85% of all management seats, or a rule first introduced in 2026.

title: Rajasthan: live registration extension
text: The original 23 October deadlines were superseded for Part 1/Part 2 by 24 October, 4 PM / 8 PM IST. The other Round 1 dates remain the checked schedule; later notices can amend them.

title: Telangana tuition: old fee block is not the new admission quote
text: G.O.107 is explicitly for 2023–2026; current 2026–27 prospectuses defer to government-notified tuition. A new applicable medical PG order was not established in the reviewed notices. MDS/MBBS orders must not be applied to MD/MS.
